steps.title: Build the First Bounded Agent Loop
steps.action: Implement a tiny `FakeModel` loop with explicit terminal state and a response cap; test normal completion and exhaustion.
steps.evidence: Working loop plus successful and capped transcript tests.

steps.title: Validate Typed Tool Call Arguments
steps.action: Implement typed arguments and deterministic fake model responses for one tool; reject malformed calls before execution.
steps.evidence: Valid and malformed tool-call fixtures.

steps.title: Connect Tool Results To Messages
steps.action: Implement model/tool transitions, terminal results, and exception propagation using deterministic responses.
steps.evidence: Successful tool scenario and exception trace.

steps.title: Verify Every Loop Stopping Condition
steps.action: Add timeout and step-budget handling; run success, malformed-call, exception, timeout, and exhaustion scenarios.
steps.evidence: All five deterministic scenarios pass.

steps.title: Build Confined Workspace Read Tools
steps.action: Implement read and exact-search tools scoped to a disposable workspace; keep command execution mocked.
steps.evidence: Read/search results remain inside the workspace.

steps.title: Add Writes And Structured Traces
steps.action: Implement workspace writes and record tool calls, outcomes, elapsed time, and actual or mocked cost.
steps.evidence: Readable trace from a read/write scenario.

steps.title: Outline Tasks And Build Fixtures
steps.action: Outline 24 task IDs with eight development and sixteen final tasks; build the first three development fixtures.
steps.evidence: Task manifest and three reproducible fixtures.

steps.title: Run Three Fixtures End To End
steps.action: Run the first three development tasks through the harness; repair fixture or tool failures and inspect complete traces.
steps.evidence: Three complete runs with outcome, time, and cost.

steps.title: Isolate Task Processes And Credentials
steps.action: Introduce fresh-process or container execution with a disposable workspace and credentials retained outside the task environment.
steps.evidence: Task execution cannot read host credentials.

steps.title: Enforce Paths And Tool Authorization
steps.action: Implement host-side tool authorization and workspace path resolution; reject traversal, escaping symlinks, and unauthorized network/tool requests.
steps.evidence: Boundary rejection cases pass.

steps.title: Bound Process Time And Output
steps.action: Add wall-time cancellation and output limits; exercise an infinite process and excessive-output fixture.
steps.evidence: Both processes stop within documented limits.

steps.title: Verify The Execution Boundary Matrix
steps.action: Run all path, symlink, timeout, output, and unauthorized-request checks; document the supported execution boundary.
steps.evidence: Automated boundary matrix passes.

steps.title: Record Events With Stable Identifiers
steps.action: Implement append-only events, stable run IDs, and explicit failure categories; read H4 on verified outcomes.
steps.evidence: One run produces an ordered event log.

steps.title: Replay Mock Runs And Inspect Traces
steps.action: Implement mock-model replay and a readable CLI or trace viewer; compare replayed tool decisions with the original trace.
steps.evidence: Deterministic replay and readable inspection.

steps.title: Complete Eight Development Task Fixtures
steps.action: Finish the remaining five development fixtures and verify every reference solution plus broken/no-op controls.
steps.evidence: Eight fixtures reject broken/no-op solutions.

steps.title: Run And Summarize Development Results
steps.action: Run all eight development tasks, categorize failures, and write a small report without inspecting final-task agent results.
steps.evidence: Development report links outcomes to traces.

steps.title: Build Clean Workspace Outcome Evaluation
steps.action: Read H3/H4 selectively; implement clean task workspaces and deterministic outcome checks in the evaluator.
steps.evidence: Reference and no-op runs produce expected grades.

steps.title: Implement the Provider Message Adapter
steps.action: Connect the raw loop to one pinned provider SDK using offline response fixtures before enabling paid requests.
steps.evidence: A tested adapter preserves tool IDs, content blocks, stop reasons, and usage without making live calls.

steps.title: Enforce Budgets and Verify the Live Adapter
steps.action: Reserve before each request, retain unknown usage, disable hidden retries, and complete one bounded live smoke loop.
steps.evidence: Fake budget enforcement tests and a bounded provider smoke trace, or explicit live blocker.

steps.title: Integrate and Inspect the Baseline Harness
steps.action: Connect pinned mini-SWE-agent to the evaluator; match feasible model/resource limits and document tool/prompt differences.
steps.evidence: Runnable baseline adapter and an honest comparison-conditions table.

steps.title: Compare Two Systems Under Declared Limits
steps.action: Run a descriptive two-task development pilot, preserving interface differences and every attempted outcome.
steps.evidence: One command emits both system tables with common limits and disclosed confounds.

steps.title: Implement Bounded Repository File Listing
steps.action: Add file listing with explicit limits and deterministic ordering; choose development tasks requiring repository navigation.
steps.evidence: Bounded listings on selected repositories.

steps.title: Combine Search With Selected File Reads
steps.action: Connect exact search and selected reads with output truncation; record when potentially relevant content was omitted.
steps.evidence: Navigation traces show truncation and selected evidence.

steps.title: Compare One Context Selection Policy
steps.action: Run one context-selection policy against the existing approach on fixed development tasks using matched model and budgets.
steps.evidence: Controlled development comparison.

steps.title: Explain Lost Evidence And Outcomes
steps.action: Inspect successful and failed traces; identify where retrieval lost necessary evidence and relate that loss to verified task outcomes.
steps.evidence: Written evidence-loss analysis linked to traces.

steps.title: Define Durable Agent Run State
steps.action: Read H5 selectively; define persisted messages, tool outcomes, workspace version, and run-state fields.
steps.evidence: State schema covers each required field.

steps.title: Persist Checkpoints Around Tool Actions
steps.action: Write and reload checkpoints before and after tool actions; record enough action state to distinguish completion from uncertainty.
steps.evidence: Reloaded state matches messages and workspace version.

steps.title: Resume And Reconcile Uncertain Actions
steps.action: Implement restart transitions; reconcile uncertain mutating actions against workspace state before deciding whether execution is safe.
steps.evidence: Resume trace documents a reconciled mutation.

steps.title: Interrupt And Verify Mutation Handling
steps.action: Interrupt immediately before and after a tool action, restart both cases, and verify edits are not silently duplicated.
steps.evidence: Both interruption scenarios pass without duplicate edits.

steps.title: Define The Compacted Context Record
steps.action: Read H5 selectively; specify objective, decisions, evidence pointers, changed files, and pending actions with an explicit compaction budget.
steps.evidence: Compaction schema and token budget.

steps.title: Implement Evidence Preserving Context Compaction
steps.action: Implement the compacted record and its insertion into subsequent model context; check that retained evidence pointers remain resolvable.
steps.evidence: Compacted example retains all required fields.

steps.title: Run The Bounded Recent History Baseline
steps.action: Implement bounded recent-history selection and compare both policies on fixed development tasks under matched budgets.
steps.evidence: Matched development traces for both policies.

steps.title: Inspect Compaction Information Loss Cases
steps.action: Inspect policy traces and produce a concrete case where summarization drops essential information; document its consequence.
steps.evidence: Explicit budget plus documented information-loss failure.

steps.title: Trace The Official MCP Tool Interface
steps.action: Read H6 selectively; map one existing read/search tool's arguments and result onto the official SDK interface.
steps.evidence: Adapter mapping preserves the existing tool contract.

steps.title: Expose One Existing Workspace Tool
steps.action: Implement the MCP adapter for that existing tool, retaining host-side permission checks.
steps.evidence: MCP tool responds to a valid request.

steps.title: Compare Direct And Protocol Invocations
steps.action: Run identical authorized and unauthorized inputs through direct invocation and the MCP adapter.
steps.evidence: Both paths return equivalent outcomes and rejections.

steps.title: Verify Protocol And Permission Boundaries
steps.action: Run the protocol smoke test and confirm permission decisions occur outside model output for both invocation paths.
steps.evidence: Smoke test passes with external permission enforcement.

steps.title: Author Final Tasks 01–04
steps.action: Prepare four final-task specifications with genuinely distinct behaviors, using the existing fixture/grader template.
steps.evidence: Four new final fixtures (final-01 through final-04) with reference-pass/no-op-fail controls and recorded task families.

steps.title: Author Final Tasks 05–08
steps.action: Author four more final fixtures and verify their reference/no-op controls without agent runs.
steps.evidence: Four new final fixtures (final-05 through final-08) with reference-pass/no-op-fail controls and recorded task families.

steps.title: Author Final Tasks 09–12
steps.action: Author four final fixtures, checking both solvability and separation from development feedback.
steps.evidence: Four new final fixtures (final-09 through final-12) with reference-pass/no-op-fail controls and recorded task families.

steps.title: Finish the Last Four Final Task Fixtures
steps.action: Create final-13 through final-16 after the three dedicated authoring batches; instantiate all sixteen without model calls.
steps.evidence: Sixteen fixtures, each with a stated outcome and reference/no-op controls.

steps.title: Verify Reference And Broken Controls
steps.action: Check reference solutions and broken/no-op controls for all final fixtures; repair invalid graders without inspecting agent performance.
steps.evidence: Final graders accept references and reject controls.

steps.title: Build the Frozen Task Manifest
steps.action: Implement a manifest builder that hashes task and grader fixtures and records the development/final split.
steps.evidence: Frozen 24-task manifest plus a mutation check that changes its identity.

steps.title: Validate Task and Grader Invariants
steps.action: Implement a model-free validator for task IDs, splits, fixture hashes, and grader references; prove malformed inputs fail.
steps.evidence: Passing manifest validation and four negative regression tests.

steps.title: Inject Model Timeout And Rate Limits
steps.action: Add controlled model-timeout and rate-limit failures; verify bounded retries distinguish retryable failures from permanent errors.
steps.evidence: Retry tests stop within configured budgets.

steps.title: Exercise Malformed Calls And Tool Crashes
steps.action: Inject malformed arguments and tool crashes; check failure categories, cancellation, and terminal outcomes.
steps.evidence: Invalid calls and crashes produce bounded outcomes.

steps.title: Recover From Stale Summaries And Restarts
steps.action: Inject a stale summary and process restart; verify recovery uses persisted evidence and reconciles uncertain side effects.
steps.evidence: Recovery traces expose stale or uncertain state.

steps.title: Verify The Complete Recovery Failure Matrix
steps.action: Run every injected failure case and inspect retry, cancellation, budget, and side-effect handling.
steps.evidence: Failure matrix distinguishes transient, permanent, and uncertain cases.

steps.title: Predeclare The Matched Harness Hypothesis
steps.action: Read H8/H4 selectively; state the recent-history versus evidence-preserving compaction hypothesis and fixed model, tools, and budgets.
steps.evidence: Written hypothesis and matched-condition specification.

steps.title: Freeze Metrics Splits And Cost Estimates
steps.action: Record outcome metrics, task splits, three repeats per condition, uncertainty approach, and estimated costs before final runs.
steps.evidence: Evaluation plan and affordable cost estimate.

steps.title: Pilot Both Policies At Context Ceiling
steps.action: Run development tasks that reach the shared context ceiling; verify each context policy activates under the same model and budgets.
steps.evidence: Pilot traces show both policies activating.

steps.title: Implement the Experiment Manifest Loader
steps.action: Validate and load a frozen experiment manifest, rejecting missing or mismatched configuration and unvalidated policies.
steps.evidence: Valid manifest load plus rejected malformed configuration cases.

steps.title: Verify Evaluation Manifest And Trial Accounting
steps.action: Verify frozen model, commits, graders, budgets, sixteen tasks, two conditions, and three repeats; prepare the 96-trial manifest.
steps.evidence: Manifest contains exactly 96 scheduled trials.

steps.title: Launch The First Matched Trial Round
steps.action: Launch one repeat across sixteen tasks and both conditions; check budget enforcement and trace capture without tuning the frozen harness.
steps.evidence: First 32 attempted trials are recorded.

steps.title: Launch The Second Matched Trial Round
steps.action: Launch the second repeat for both conditions; retain failures and timeouts with deterministic grades and actual usage.
steps.evidence: Next 32 attempted trials retain all outcomes.

steps.title: Complete Trials and Verify Outcome Accounting
steps.action: Launch the third repeat if the budget allows; reconcile all96 planned rows with attempted, running, terminal, or unattempted status.
steps.evidence: An evidence-linked96-row manifest with complete attempted accounting or an explicit predeclared budget shortfall.

steps.title: Group Private Suite Failures And Costs
steps.action: Group all private-study attempts by task, condition, failure category, time, and cost; retain truncated runs as failures.
steps.evidence: Private-suite outcome and cost tables.

steps.title: Inspect Representative Private Task Failure Traces
steps.action: Inspect representative failures to explain policy behavior and evidence loss without modifying the frozen result.
steps.evidence: Trace-linked private-study failure analysis.

steps.title: Run The Optional Frozen External Pilot
steps.action: Only if setup and budget gates passed, launch twenty external trials; otherwise deepen the required private-study analysis.
steps.evidence: Twenty external attempts or documented skip.

steps.title: Validate Evaluation Result Tables
steps.action: Join results against the frozen manifest and detect duplicate, missing, mislabelled, or malformed trial records.
steps.evidence: Audited private-task result table and negative input tests.

steps.title: Audit Outcome Graders Against Saved Evidence
steps.action: Read H4/H8 selectively; inspect saved task outcomes against deterministic grades and representative success/failure traces.
steps.evidence: Grading audit with discrepancies explicitly recorded.

steps.title: Reconcile Run Budgets And Actual Charges
steps.action: Audit model usage, retries, budget reservations, actual charges, and stopped runs against reported per-trial costs.
steps.evidence: Reconciled cost and budget accounting.

steps.title: Calculate Uncertainty Across Paired Task Results
steps.action: Calculate uncertainty summaries that preserve task grouping and repeated trials; state the small-suite limitations.
steps.evidence: Per-task clustered analysis and uncertainty summary.

steps.title: Generate Claims From Audited Evidence
steps.action: Generate a compact findings table from validated records with explicit numerators, denominators, and uncertainty.
steps.evidence: Tested findings generator, one supported claim, and a follow-up hypothesis.

steps.title: Test Reproduction From a Clean Environment
steps.action: Implement a fresh-environment reproduction smoke check for the loop, resume, and failure cases; audit saved evaluation statuses without new paid runs.
steps.evidence: Clean-environment smoke output and an intentional missing-dependency failure.

steps.title: Build a Minimal Upstream Regression Case
steps.action: Reduce one integration problem encountered during the course to a minimal reproducer or regression test against the relevant project.
steps.evidence: Small reproducible case, expected behavior, and a tested fix or precise issue draft.
